scenes.heading: VocalKeep
scenes.voice: Hey, I’ve been playing with a tool that strips music from videos while keeping the speech. Let me show you.

scenes.heading: Music drowns dialogue
scenes.voice: Ever watched a short where the beat covers the speaker? It’s frustrating.

scenes.heading: What it does
scenes.voice: The pipeline runs locally, no cloud, and gives you a speech‑only clip.

scenes.heading: Local web UI
scenes.voice: You can open a tiny web page, drag a video, pick a model, and download the cleaned result.

scenes.heading: Hardware support
bullets: Supports NVIDIA, AMD ROCm, Apple MPS
scenes.voice: It checks each device with a tiny tensor before trusting it, so older cards fall back to CPU safely.

scenes.heading: Project roadmap
scenes.voice: We’ve already shipped the core engine and a web UI; the next step is a Chrome extension for right‑click processing.

scenes.heading: Try it yourself
scenes.voice: Check out the repository on GitHub, clone it, and run the local server to clean your videos today.
